documents.text: The Aurora X1 launched on March 4, 2025. It is our flagship laptop with a 14 inch display and 18 hour battery life.
All Aurora products carry a 2 year warranty measured from the product launch date. Warranty claims require proof of purchase.
The Aurora X1 weighs 1.2 kilograms and ships with 16 gigabytes of memory. Ports include two USB-C and one HDMI.

expected: Combine both facts: launch March 4 2025 plus 2 year warranty gives an expiry of March 4 2027. Both documents must be cited.
query: When does the warranty expire for the Aurora X1?
